form:FormGroup.label: Statistic Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Count records the number of events; Value records a numeric value from each event, e.g. a size or duration. Must match the type of the statistic events sent to this store.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Count of events, or a numeric value per event.

form:FormGroup.label: Precision
form:FormGroup.helpText: The time bucket that events are grouped into when stored: Second, Minute, Hour or Day. Smaller buckets give more detail but use more storage. Default is Hour.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Smallest time bucket for stored values. Default is Hour.

form:FormGroup.label: Roll Up Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: Which tag combinations are also stored with tag values replaced by '*', so they can be queried quickly. None stores no roll-ups, All stores every combination, Custom stores only the combinations you define.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: None, All, or Custom combinations of rolled-up tags.
